From the looks of it, you don't have any msata slots, so the msata and m.2 drives are out. That leaves you with SATA drives, basically (you can get a PCIe drive if you are insane, but I don't think you need that level of read/write speeds.) I would suggest at least a 240GB SATA SSD, minimum of 120GB, at least for an operating system drive.

Solid state drives are extremely useful: it cuts down load times for operating systems and programs to a tenth of what they would be on a normal hard drive.
